# Faceless dropshipping guide reel for Instagram, made with AI

**A product, its cost and its sell price become a 60-second faceless reel with price math, steps and a comment CTA.**

<p><img src="https://s3.varg.ai/files/194b94d0-58ff-4e8b-91de-4f1959d04013/file_c3e193ed875e.webp" alt="A faceless dropshipping reel: an LED pet nail clipper on a cat paw, then a hand circles the $24.99 store price on a laptop over a zigzag tablecloth." width="480"></p>

Makes the 60-second faceless dropshipping "guide" reel end to end: a viral-looking product hook, a laptop on a zigzag tablecloth with a hand pointing a marker at the product cost, the store price and the demand chart, then each step (research tool → store → AI ad tool → Instagram → supplier ships), and a night-skyline ending shot on an iPhone with "Comment GUIDE". Script template, AI shots on varg (Seedance 2.5, GPT Image 2.5, Wan 3, ElevenLabs), word-by-word lime captions, the comment-to-DM funnel. Use when an e-commerce seller, dropshipper, affiliate of a product-research or AI-ad tool, or course creator asks for a product reel like @tradelle's, "a reel showing a product, its price in China and on Shopify", a "comment GUIDE" reel, a laptop-and-pen screen walkthrough, or one such reel per product every day. Not for the hook alone (use varg-product-hook), talking-head UGC ads, or screen recordings of software with a cursor (find those with video-skills).

```bash
npx skills add vargHQ/skills --skill varg-dropship-reel                # Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Grok, Gemini CLI, OpenCode…
gh skill install vargHQ/skills varg-dropship-reel --agent github-copilot --scope user
# or all 73 skills as a Claude Code plugin:
claude plugin marketplace add vargHQ/skills
claude plugin install varg@varg
```

| | |
|---|---|
| Makes | 60 s 9:16 MP4 reel with captions |
| Needs | a varg account (OAuth through the varg MCP) or `VARG_API_KEY` |
| Typical cost | ~$12.50 for the first reel, ~$8.60 per next product (tested) |
| Uses | varg API, Seedance 2.5, Kling 4, GPT Image 2.5, Wan 3, ElevenLabs v4, Whisper, FFmpeg |
| Works in | Claude Code, Codex, Grok, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Copilot, OpenCode and other Agent Skills tools |
| Agent instructions | [SKILL.md](./SKILL.md) (v1.1.0) |

## Ask your agent

- "Make a 60-second dropshipping guide reel for this posture corrector: it costs $4 and sells for $29"
- "Make one "Comment GUIDE" reel per product every day from my store screenshots in ./screens/"
- "Make a faceless reel with a laptop and a hand with a marker pointing at the price and the demand chart"
